name: Probe: engine era timing with Eras_XP1 min=max (3,5,1,2 turns, then 2/4) and NEXT_ERA_TURN_COUNTDOWN 1 at GAMESPEED_QUICK, 16 single-turn autoplays logging [JAC_ERA_PROBE] from GameCore and InGame (unification test map, Oda human)

steps.code:
GameConfiguration.SetValue('JAC_ERA_TIMING_TAIL', false)
if GameConfiguration.GetValue('JAC_ERA_TIMING_TAIL')~=false then error('tail fixture flag not cleared') end
return true

JAC_ERP={ctx='GameCore'}; local P=JAC_ERP
function P.q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end; return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end
function P.call(obj,name) if obj==nil then return 'noobj' end; local okf,f=pcall(function() return obj[name] end); if not okf or type(f)~='function' then return 'absent' end; local ok,v=pcall(f,obj); if ok then return tostring(v) end; return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end
function P.eraName(i) local n=tonumber(i); local r=n and GameInfo.Eras[n]; return r and r.EraType or '?' end
function P.count(list,has) local n=0; for row in list do if has(row.Index) then n=n+1 end end; return n end
function P.Log(tag)
  local turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); local start=GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()
  local okE,eras=pcall(Game.GetEras); if not okE then eras=nil end
  local era=P.call(eras,'GetCurrentEra')
  local t={'ctx='..P.ctx,'tag='..tag,'turn='..turn,'elapsed='..(turn-start+1),'date='..P.q(function() return Calendar.MakeYearStr(turn) end),'era='..era..':'..P.eraName(era),'eraStart='..P.call(eras,'GetCurrentEraStartTurn'),'countdown='..P.call(eras,'GetNextEraCountdown'),'minEnd='..P.call(eras,'GetCurrentEraMinimumEndTurn'),'maxEnd='..P.call(eras,'GetCurrentEraMaximumEndTurn'),'final='..P.call(eras,'GetFinalEra')}
  if P.last~=nil and P.last~=era then t[#t+1]='CHANGED from='..P.eraName(P.last)..' eraLenObserved='..tostring(turn-(P.lastStart or turn)) end
  if P.last~=era then P.lastStart=turn end
  P.last=era
  t[#t+1]='players='..P.q(function() local s={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id=p:GetID(); s[#s+1]='p'..id..':era='..P.call(p,'GetEra')..':'..P.eraName(P.call(p,'GetEra'))..'/techs='..P.q(function() local x=p:GetTechs(); return P.count(GameInfo.Technologies(),function(i) return x:HasTech(i) end) end)..'/civics='..P.q(function() local x=p:GetCulture(); return P.count(GameInfo.Civics(),function(i) return x:HasCivic(i) end) end) end; return table.concat(s,',') end)
  local line='[JAC_ERA_PROBE] '..table.concat(t,' ')
  print(line); return line
end
return JAC_ERP.Log('setup')

'..rows[#rows]) end end
local cd=GameInfo.GlobalParameters['NEXT_ERA_TURN_COUNTDOWN']; if not cd or tostring(cd.Value)~='1' then error('NEXT_ERA_TURN_COUNTDOWN is '..tostring(cd and cd.Value)) end
local sp=GameConfiguration.GetGameSpeedType(); if sp~='GAMESPEED_QUICK' and sp~=DB.MakeHash('GAMESPEED_QUICK') then error('wrong game speed: '..tostring(sp)) end
local date=Calendar.MakeYearStr(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()); if not string.find(date,'1534',1,true) then error('Sengoku calendar not active: '..tostring(date)) end
local speedRow=GameInfo.GameSpeeds['GAMESPEED_QUICK']
local head='[JAC_ERA_PROBE] ctx=InGame tag=config speed='..'GAMESPEED_QUICK'..' costMultiplier='..tostring(speedRow and speedRow.CostMultiplier)..' countdownParam='..tostring(cd.Value)..' eras_xp1='..table.concat(rows,',')
